item.title: Mayday Parade Reveals Details Of Upcoming Psychological Horror Graphic Novel
item.description: Mayday Parade has just revealed something that’s been in the works for quite some time. The group is officially gearing up to release their own psychological horror graphic novel via Sumerian Comics. Mayday Parade: The Faceless follows the band’s iconic “umbrella man,” and is set for shipping on May 29.
